final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM film GROUP BY rating), s2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.rating, s1.avg_len, s1.avg_ratio, s1.avg_ratio - s2.overall AS diff FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.overall IS NOT NULL WHERE s1.avg_ratio > s2.overall) SELECT AVG(avg_len), AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(diff) FROM s3
